title: Low Fat Lovely Algerian Lamb Tagine
description: A sweet and velvety Algerian dish made with ground annatto and lamb, perfect for a post-workout meal, cooked in a ceramic tagine and pressure cooker for a low-fat friendly option.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the ground lamb and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the ground annatto, dried apricots, chicken broth, honey, ground cinnamon, ground ginger, salt, and black pepper to the tagine.
Stir to combine and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Transfer the tagine to a pressure cooker and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the tagine from the pressure cooker and let it cool slightly before serving.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
